description: This PHP script is part of the vtiger CRM system, specifically for the Settings module. It initializes the Smarty templating engine, assigns various language and theme variables, determines the view status, and renders the 'DefModuleView.tpl' template to display the module view configuration within the settings section.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty extension class used for rendering templates within vtiger CRM.
